observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 35 stand in the left margin and the locators «p. 92.» (L11) and «p. 93.» (L35) in the right margin.

body L12: the small raised ring of the degrees stands after the 4 of «4° 1/2», where a number of times is meant (note 4 refers to p. 60, line 15: the diameter of the Sun 5 1/2 diameters of the Earth); transcribed as printed.
notes_left L1, L3: the fractions are set over their bars, in the line of note 1 and in a line of their own in note 2; the full stop after the formula of note 1 stands raised.
notes_right L6: the dash at the head of the formula is the sign of the subtraction.
notes_right L7: the note ends with the closing quotation sign, without a full stop.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
